You are a register judge for one person's working chat. Judge the TEXT below against the laws stated here.
Each law names a CLASS, so judge by MEANING rather than by matching particular words.

LAW 1 — no coined or jargon term shown to the reader without a plain gloss. A word the reader may not know — a name this project coined for its own machinery, or a piece of domain jargon — dropped into a sentence with no plain-language gloss on first use is banned (e.g. «развилки» shown in chat where the reader was never taught the term). Name the thing in the reader's own plain words, or gloss the term the first time it appears. A widely understood industry-standard word needs no gloss and passes.
Reader test: Would a person outside this project recognize this word, or does the text gloss it in plain words where it first appears?
Exceptions: a term the text glosses in plain words at its first use; a term holding a glossary entry the reader meets before the term's first working use.

LAW 2 — no machine dialect in a surface a human reads: a word this project coined where the industry already has one, an English internal term loan-translated word for word into the reader's own language (a calque), or an English coinage respelled in the reader's alphabet. Judge by whether an outside reader, never taught this project's private vocabulary, would meet a word as machinery where meaning belongs. A plain industry-standard word passes, and so does an ordinary word that merely happens to appear inside such a coinage.
Reader test: Does a standard word already name this thing? Is the word used here that standard word, written as a real word of the reader's own language?
Exception: a minted name for a thing nothing else names, carrying a glossary entry at its first appearance.

LAW 3 — no naming a thing by denying its neighbour. The banned frame is 'X, not Y' / 'X — not Y', and in Russian «X, а не Y». It is banned when the denied half adds nothing the reader did not already have. A contrast between two things that BOTH genuinely exist and are both live for the reader is legitimate and passes.
Reader test: Does the denied half give the reader anything the reader did not already have?
Exception: a contrast between two things that both genuinely exist and are both live for the reader.

LAW 4 — no bare internal code opening a sentence to the human. A sentence shown to the person must not LEAD with an internal handle as its first token — an invariant code (INV-237), a roadmap or matrix row (row 422, M-419), a milestone or entity code (M-6, E-13, T-22), or a bare section number. The handle may TRAIL the plain sentence in parentheses as a quiet anchor once the words have carried the meaning; only a code standing as the opening token offends. Leading with the code is the agent talking to itself in its own filing system rather than to the reader. A sentence that opens in plain words and closes with a parenthetical anchor passes.
Reader test: Does the sentence still carry its meaning with the code removed, and does the code stand anywhere other than at the end?

LAW 5 — no grading importance or quality without a concrete fact. Praising or grading the WORTH of a thing — a thought, a result, a phrase, a rhyme, a design, a change — with an evaluative word and no fact behind it is banned. Grading how important, how good, or how strong something is, up or down, is the reader's own act; the text states what the thing IS or DOES and lets the reader weigh it. Banned as a class in any language: «сильная мысль», «сильный результат», «красивая рифма», «в разы лучше», "a strong point", "a beautiful solution", "far better", used as a verdict on worth rather than a statement of fact. A word that carries a FACT stays: "cuts the query from 900ms to 40ms" is a fact and passes; "much faster" with no number is a grade and offends. The class covers both poles — inflating up and dramatizing down are one bias — and it grades ANY object, a result included.
Reader test: Does this sentence tell the reader how much to care about what it reports?

LAW 6 — no sentence that carries no information. This is compaction turned on what he reads: every
sentence shown to him advances the finding, the decision, or the action. A sentence that only performs a
stance, prefaces or frames without content, restates what he already has, softens, or ceremonially opens
or closes is cut before sending. The laws below name the sharp instances of this class (empty intensifier,
validation of the person or self-praise); this law governs the whole class, so a zero-information sentence
in a wording no instance names still offends here. A sentence carrying a fact, a number, a name, a
consequence, or a next step passes.

LAW 7 — no empty intensifier. A word or phrase that inflates a statement while adding no information is
banned. It reads as performing conviction in place of carrying a fact. Examples of the class, in any
language: "really", "actually", "truly", "in fact", "genuinely", «по-настоящему», «реально», «на самом
деле», «действительно», "this changes everything", "at its core", any adjective grading how important a
result is. A word that carries a FACT stays: "three lanes" is a fact, "really important" is not.

LAW 8 — no validation of the person, and no self-praise. Two poles of one class, judged by meaning in
any language. FIRST, a sentence whose content is a verdict on the reader — his remark, his question, his
intuition, his instinct — rather than an answer to it: "good question", "you caught that exactly",
"you're right" / "you're not wrong" as an opener, "fair point", "your intuition is right", "you're onto
something", «хороший вопрос», «верно подметил», «ты прав», «твоя интуиция в точку», «в точку». SECOND, a
clause that grades the AGENT's OWN act or result. One shape grades the act as superior — more honest,
more rigorous, better than the alternative it just chose over: "measured, not guessed", "this is the
honest way", «честнее, чем на глаз», «стоит померить, а не обсуждать на глаз». Another shape grades the
result's own worth or payoff without carrying the fact that would show it: "it immediately paid off",
"this proved its worth", "the effort was worth it", «сразу окупилось», «оправдало себя», «не зря»,
«принесло плоды», «сработало как надо». Both are the agent performing a stance in place of
carrying the finding; the payoff, if real, is stated as the finding itself ("the extended lint found 90
frames the old one passed") and the reader grades it. Delete the validating or self-praising clause and open with the substance.
Confirming a FACT the reader asserted passes, because that is information; stating what the agent DID
without grading it passes.

Return STRICT JSON, nothing else, no prose, no code fence:
{"offences": [{"quote": "<the offending sentence copied VERBATIM from the text; if it runs longer than
80 characters, copy only its first 80 characters exactly as written — no ellipsis, no added quotation
marks, no changed punctuation, so the quote is always an exact span of the text>",
"law": <the law number>, "why": "<at most 12 words: what it carries no information toward>"}]}

An empty list is the right answer for a clean text, and it is the answer most texts deserve. Judge only
what the text asserts. Ignore file paths, code, command output, and any text the author is QUOTING
rather than asserting.

---

## 2. Documentation information architecture

Диагноз: канон весит ≈1.7 MB при потолках, которые уже почти выбраны (`PRODUCT_SPEC` 703 512 / 840 000 B; `TEST_MATRIX` 484 273 / 530 000; `JOURNAL` 368 724 / 640 000; `ROADMAP` 301 305 / 700 000). Механизма progressive disclosure нет: `references/` есть у 3 из 12 skills, но ни правила, ни триггера, ни гейта. Ротация есть (gate t/z), декомпозиция по требованию — нет.

Единственное новое нормативное правило, которое поправка вводит:

> **Disclosure law.** Every canonical document declares three tiers: `always` (the router's selectors), `on-route` (loaded when a route names it), `on-ask` (loaded on the person's word). A tier is declared in the document's own header, not in a separate registry. A fact has one home and one tier; a second full statement in another tier is drift (INV-13).

| document | audience | purpose | canonical content | must NOT live there | duplication to replace with links | always | on-route | on-ask | budget / decomposition rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` | owner + prover | the promise | requirements, `shall` clauses, INV/E/T codes, glossary | history, plans, status, rationale essays | rationale duplicated in JOURNAL → link | — | **the cited requirement only** | full body | 840 KB cap holds; **split per requirement file** `spec/R<n>.md` with `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` as the index; criterion-readability `max_words: 35` stays |
| `PRODUCT_SPEC.index.md` | machines | code → location | generated table | anything hand-written | — | ✓ (28 KB) | — | — | generated by gate x; never edited |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | builder | who owns which anchor | nodes, seams, pins, runtime/placement views | behaviour promises, test detail | node prose restating spec clauses → cite the code | — | **the owning node** | full | 107 KB; `node-file-cap.json` (2 nodes/file) becomes the split rule |
| `TEST_MATRIX.md` | test author | fact-level coverage | one row per fact, test level | test bodies, rationale | matrix rows restating spec sentences → cite anchor | — | **rows of the route's anchors** | full | 530 KB cap; **split per node block** |
| `ROADMAP.md` | owner | the queue, five cells | id · wish · class · status · acceptance | statements, estimates, board rendering | intake notes (`door:`/`kind:`/`footprint:`/`map:`) → move to the board source file | — | ✓ head + in-work | full | 245 rows; closing-commit rotation (INV-276) |
| `DECISIONS.md` | owner | durable rulings | dated verdicts, on record / open / struck | plans, status | rulings restated in ROADMAP cells → link | — | ✓ the route's ruling | full | 50 KB; ok |
| `SURFACES.md` | reader-facing checks | surface registry | name · needle · anchors | prose | — | ✓ (779 B) | — | — | **owes a `work-board` row** (R309 clause 9) |
| `.live-spec/PROBLEMS.md` | owner | problem ledger | open problems + ARCHIVED | tasks, plans | — | — | ✓ | full | milestone compaction |
| `docs/PROGRESS.md` | owner | measured promises | readings, what no measure covers | plans, campaign prose | — | — | ✓ | full | 16 KB |
| `OVERVIEW.md` / `README.md` | stranger | five-minute map / install | rendered claims with needles | rules, history | — | — | — | ✓ | update **after** a vertical slice proves the claim |
| skills + `references/` | the agent | how to do the step | the step's craft | shared laws (base owns them) | INV-13 drift | **router only** | SKILL.md of the named route | references/ | **base 64 KB → thin router ≤4 KB + on-demand modules**; every `references/*.md` gains an explicit trigger line |

Сохраняется всё: сценарии, rationale, примеры, исключения и traceability не удаляются — они переезжают из `always` в `on-route`/`on-ask`. Читаемость обеспечивается уже существующими лимитами (`criterion-readability`, `doc-bounds`, `rule-census`), плюс новым правилом раскрытия.

---

## 3. Human-facing work graph

**Ответ на оборванный вопрос: канонической поверхностью владеет уже существующая пара — `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` Requirement 309 `[feature: F-work-board]` + `ARCHITECTURE.md [node: work-board]`.** Ни `cards.yaml`, ни второго источника истины не требуется, потому что слот уже нормирован:

- clause 7 — `The system shall hold the work board as one source file in the host's tree. [INV-308]`
- clause 42 — `keep a task's statement and its validation record in the work board's own source file, keyed by the queue row's id, the queue row keeping its five cells. [INV-309, INV-277]`
- clause 98 — `write on the work board no history the journal already owns. [INV-308]`

То есть разделение уже задано: **`ROADMAP.md` = пять ячеек очереди (id · wish · class · status · acceptance); board source file = statement + validation record + craft set, keyed by row id; `JOURNAL.md` = история; `DECISIONS.md` = решения; delivery report = step trail.** Файл не назван — поправка предлагает имя `.live-spec/board.md` и это **единственное новое имя** во всём дизайне.

Как сообщение чата становится работой:

| шаг | норма | где живёт |
|---|---|---|
| attach or create | router matches the message against open row ids and statements; a match appends a dated widening to that row, else opens a new row | ROADMAP row (existing widening practice, row 166 has six) |
| classify | `question · idea · feature · bug · decision · debt · local change` — the five doors plus `question` (no artifact) and `idea`/`debt` (park with a revisit trigger) | intake note, moved into the board source file |
| provenance | every widening carries attributor + date + the person's own words, as rows already do (`Alexander 2026-08-06 ~21:00`) | ROADMAP cell 2 → board `words[]` |
| stage | `backlog → inception → ready → in work → done` | **spec drift to fix**: clause 20 still says four columns; DECISIONS.md:117 and row 166 say five |
| owner / pipeline / worktree / agents | lane record seam already specified (`branch`, `worktree`, cap-split lanes) | board source file, read from the lane's claim commit + checkpoint |
| dependencies | **gap**: no schema field; today only free prose and a `blocked` mark (clause 18) | poprawka: add `blocks: [<row-id>]` to the board source file, not to ROADMAP's five cells |
| evidence | link only — spec anchor, matrix rows, prover record, commit | board never restates them (clause 98) |
| history without chat noise | card face carries echo-name · description · chips; everything else behind a details layer; far tier collapsed to a count | already normative in M-524 / M-526 |
| parallel vs serial | in-work column splits into lanes by cap; a parked row names the row that preempted it | M-525 |
| readable to a non-technical owner | echo-name first, feature language, frozen norm `docs/norms/work-board.html` | clause 15, INV-43 |

Три расхождения, которые поправка обязана закрыть **до** реализации, иначе доска родится противоречивой:

1. **Columns:** spec clause 20 = four; DECISIONS.md:117 + row 166 = five (inception добавлен). Spec ещё не догнал решение.
2. **Status vocabulary:** объявлено пять слов, в файле живут шесть — `*queued*` 181, `*deferred*` 35, `*landed*` 11 (вне словаря), `*in-work*` 6, `*far*` 4, `*ready*` 2. Колонка «ready» пуста именно поэтому; строка 566 существует, чтобы это закрыть.
3. **`task graph` и `word-history`** записаны только в ROADMAP row 166 и DECISIONS, но **отсутствуют в Requirement 309** — то есть не имеют ни матричных строк, ни тестов.

---

## 4. Shadow mode и первый vertical slice

Shadow остаётся как в мастер-плане: роутер печатает `task type · reach/risk · selected route · owner · agents/worktrees · required proof · fallback · sources used` и ничего не исполняет; старый LiveSpec исполняет; расхождение предсказания с фактическим вердиктом `check-push-reach.sh` — сигнал качества. Измеряется **hook-meter** (28 156 записей, живой), а не `net_meter` (ноль вызывающих, лога нет) — это исправление моего прошлого предложения.

**Первый vertical slice — ровно один, и он не про доску:**

> Shadow-route two real changes (one local, one cross-cutting). The router emits its trace only. No file is written except the trace. The old pipeline executes both.

Причина, по которой slice не трогает доску: доска — это 98 клауз, 19 матричных строк `*todo*` и три незакрытых расхождения выше. Она идёт после R0, не в первом срезе.

## 5. Что блокирует всё остальное (R0, порядок)

1. **Установленный `pre-push` расходится с исходником** (10 099 vs 10 783 B; отсутствует stand-down gate a). Любое измерение shadow-режима сейчас сравнивается с не тем гейтом.
2. **CI на main красный четыре прогона подряд.** Базовая линия не может начинаться с красного.
3. **Решение владельца по `lanes.cap`** — фиксированные 3 против ёмкости по бюджету/reach/ресурсам.
4. **Три расхождения work board** (columns, status vocabulary, task graph / word-history).
5. **`check-pack-update` stamp несвежий на 27 дней**; `net_meter`, `reap_owned_group`, `check-runaway-child` реализованы и протестированы, но не вооружены.

Ничего не изменено, не создано и не запущено; отчёт read-only.

more rigorous, better than the alternative it just chose over: "measured, not guessed", "this is the
honest way", «честнее, чем на глаз», «стоит померить, а не обсуждать на глаз». Another shape grades the

frames the old one passed") and the reader grades it. Delete the validating or self-praising clause and open with the substance.

## 2. Documentation information architecture

Диагноз: канон весит ≈1.7 MB при потолках, которые уже почти выбраны (`PRODUCT_SPEC` 703 512 / 840 000 B; `TEST_MATRIX` 484 273 / 530 000; `JOURNAL` 368 724 / 640 000; `ROADMAP` 301 305 / 700 000). Механизма progressive disclosure нет: `references/` есть у 3 из 12 skills, но ни правила, ни триггера, ни гейта. Ротация есть (gate t/z), декомпозиция по требованию — нет.

Единственное новое нормативное правило, которое поправка вводит:

> **Disclosure law.** Every canonical document declares three tiers: `always` (the router's selectors), `on-route` (loaded when a route names it), `on-ask` (loaded on the person's word). A tier is declared in the document's own header, not in a separate registry. A fact has one home and one tier; a second full statement in another tier is drift (INV-13).

| document | audience | purpose | canonical content | must NOT live there | duplication to replace with links | always | on-route | on-ask | budget / decomposition rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` | owner + prover | the promise | requirements, `shall` clauses, INV/E/T codes, glossary | history, plans, status, rationale essays | rationale duplicated in JOURNAL → link | — | **the cited requirement only** | full body | 840 KB cap holds; **split per requirement file** `spec/R<n>.md` with `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` as the index; criterion-readability `max_words: 35` stays |
| `PRODUCT_SPEC.index.md` | machines | code → location | generated table | anything hand-written | — | ✓ (28 KB) | — | — | generated by gate x; never edited |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | builder | who owns which anchor | nodes, seams, pins, runtime/placement views | behaviour promises, test detail | node prose restating spec clauses → cite the code | — | **the owning node** | full | 107 KB; `node-file-cap.json` (2 nodes/file) becomes the split rule |
| `TEST_MATRIX.md` | test author | fact-level coverage | one row per fact, test level | test bodies, rationale | matrix rows restating spec sentences → cite anchor | — | **rows of the route's anchors** | full | 530 KB cap; **split per node block** |
| `ROADMAP.md` | owner | the queue, five cells | id · wish · class · status · acceptance | statements, estimates, board rendering | intake notes (`door:`/`kind:`/`footprint:`/`map:`) → move to the board source file | — | ✓ head + in-work | full | 245 rows; closing-commit rotation (INV-276) |
| `DECISIONS.md` | owner | durable rulings | dated verdicts, on record / open / struck | plans, status | rulings restated in ROADMAP cells → link | — | ✓ the route's ruling | full | 50 KB; ok |
| `SURFACES.md` | reader-facing checks | surface registry | name · needle · anchors | prose | — | ✓ (779 B) | — | — | **owes a `work-board` row** (R309 clause 9) |
| `.live-spec/PROBLEMS.md` | owner | problem ledger | open problems + ARCHIVED | tasks, plans | — | — | ✓ | full | milestone compaction |
| `docs/PROGRESS.md` | owner | measured promises | readings, what no measure covers | plans, campaign prose | — | — | ✓ | full | 16 KB |
| `OVERVIEW.md` / `README.md` | stranger | five-minute map / install | rendered claims with needles | rules, history | — | — | — | ✓ | update **after** a vertical slice proves the claim |
| skills + `references/` | the agent | how to do the step | the step's craft | shared laws (base owns them) | INV-13 drift | **router only** | SKILL.md of the named route | references/ | **base 64 KB → thin router ≤4 KB + on-demand modules**; every `references/*.md` gains an explicit trigger line |

Сохраняется всё: сценарии, rationale, примеры, исключения и traceability не удаляются — они переезжают из `always` в `on-route`/`on-ask`. Читаемость обеспечивается уже существующими лимитами (`criterion-readability`, `doc-bounds`, `rule-census`), плюс новым правилом раскрытия.

---

## 3. Human-facing work graph

**Ответ на оборванный вопрос: канонической поверхностью владеет уже существующая пара — `PRODUCT_SPEC.md` Requirement 309 `[feature: F-work-board]` + `ARCHITECTURE.md [node: work-board]`.** Ни `cards.yaml`, ни второго источника истины не требуется, потому что слот уже нормирован:

- clause 7 — `The system shall hold the work board as one source file in the host's tree. [INV-308]`
- clause 42 — `keep a task's statement and its validation record in the work board's own source file, keyed by the queue row's id, the queue row keeping its five cells. [INV-309, INV-277]`
- clause 98 — `write on the work board no history the journal already owns. [INV-308]`

То есть разделение уже задано: **`ROADMAP.md` = пять ячеек очереди (id · wish · class · status · acceptance); board source file = statement + validation record + craft set, keyed by row id; `JOURNAL.md` = история; `DECISIONS.md` = решения; delivery report = step trail.** Файл не назван — поправка предлагает имя `.live-spec/board.md` и это **единственное новое имя** во всём дизайне.

Как сообщение чата становится работой:

| шаг | норма | где живёт |
|---|---|---|
| attach or create | router matches the message against open row ids and statements; a match appends a dated widening to that row, else opens a new row | ROADMAP row (existing widening practice, row 166 has six) |
| classify | `question · idea · feature · bug · decision · debt · local change` — the five doors plus `question` (no artifact) and `idea`/`debt` (park with a revisit trigger) | intake note, moved into the board source file |
| provenance | every widening carries attributor + date + the person's own words, as rows already do (`Alexander 2026-08-06 ~21:00`) | ROADMAP cell 2 → board `words[]` |
| stage | `backlog → inception → ready → in work → done` | **spec drift to fix**: clause 20 still says four columns; DECISIONS.md:117 and row 166 say five |
| owner / pipeline / worktree / agents | lane record seam already specified (`branch`, `worktree`, cap-split lanes) | board source file, read from the lane's claim commit + checkpoint |
| dependencies | **gap**: no schema field; today only free prose and a `blocked` mark (clause 18) | poprawka: add `blocks: [<row-id>]` to the board source file, not to ROADMAP's five cells |
| evidence | link only — spec anchor, matrix rows, prover record, commit | board never restates them (clause 98) |
| history without chat noise | card face carries echo-name · description · chips; everything else behind a details layer; far tier collapsed to a count | already normative in M-524 / M-526 |
| parallel vs serial | in-work column splits into lanes by cap; a parked row names the row that preempted it | M-525 |
| readable to a non-technical owner | echo-name first, feature language, frozen norm `docs/norms/work-board.html` | clause 15, INV-43 |

Три расхождения, которые поправка обязана закрыть **до** реализации, иначе доска родится противоречивой:

1. **Columns:** spec clause 20 = four; DECISIONS.md:117 + row 166 = five (inception добавлен). Spec ещё не догнал решение.
2. **Status vocabulary:** объявлено пять слов, в файле живут шесть — `*queued*` 181, `*deferred*` 35, `*landed*` 11 (вне словаря), `*in-work*` 6, `*far*` 4, `*ready*` 2. Колонка «ready» пуста именно поэтому; строка 566 существует, чтобы это закрыть.
3. **`task graph` и `word-history`** записаны только в ROADMAP row 166 и DECISIONS, но **отсутствуют в Requirement 309** — то есть не имеют ни матричных строк, ни тестов.

---

## 4. Shadow mode и первый vertical slice

Shadow остаётся как в мастер-плане: роутер печатает `task type · reach/risk · selected route · owner · agents/worktrees · required proof · fallback · sources used` и ничего не исполняет; старый LiveSpec исполняет; расхождение предсказания с фактическим вердиктом `check-push-reach.sh` — сигнал качества. Измеряется **hook-meter** (28 156 записей, живой), а не `net_meter` (ноль вызывающих, лога нет) — это исправление моего прошлого предложения.

**Первый vertical slice — ровно один, и он не про доску:**

> Shadow-route two real changes (one local, one cross-cutting). The router emits its trace only. No file is written except the trace. The old pipeline executes both.

Причина, по которой slice не трогает доску: доска — это 98 клауз, 19 матричных строк `*todo*` и три незакрытых расхождения выше. Она идёт после R0, не в первом срезе.

## 5. Что блокирует всё остальное (R0, порядок)

1. **Установленный `pre-push` расходится с исходником** (10 099 vs 10 783 B; отсутствует stand-down gate a). Любое измерение shadow-режима сейчас сравнивается с не тем гейтом.
2. **CI на main красный четыре прогона подряд.** Базовая линия не может начинаться с красного.
3. **Решение владельца по `lanes.cap`** — фиксированные 3 против ёмкости по бюджету/reach/ресурсам.
4. **Три расхождения work board** (columns, status vocabulary, task graph / word-history).
5. **`check-pack-update` stamp несвежий на 27 дней**; `net_meter`, `reap_owned_group`, `check-runaway-child` реализованы и протестированы, но не вооружены.

Ничего не изменено, не создано и не запущено; отчёт read-only.
